newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel premiums steady, trade inactive.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel premiums steady, trade inactive.

text.p: NWE jet fuel premiums were steady in inactive trade marked by post-holiday lethargy on Thursday, traders said.
"It's very thin, with very little talk," one trader said.
Benchmark Jan IPE gas oil futures was at 1705 GMT trading $7.00 a tonne higher at $230.75 a tonne on freezing weather in Europe.

Traders saw scattered enquiries for NWE cargoes but little availability. Premiums were Jan IPE +$28/29, around $1 higher. Barges were around Jan IPE +$26. Asian arbitrage for dual purpose kerosene remains open in the Mediterranean but there is a scarcity of vessels
